prompt: I want a unit-testable contrast checker for text colors in our UIKit app, supporting iOS 26 and later. We use semantic UIColors and some custom colors, so the values can change in dark mode and with Increase Contrast. Some callers may also supply transparent colors or colors created in a different color space. Can you show a focused implementation and tests for our configured foreground/background pairs? Use a 4.5 ratio as our small-text check, handle inputs you cannot evaluate explicitly, and explain what a passing result actually establishes. We are not doing screenshot or UI tests.
